title: Grusch: disgruntled insiders inside the legacy program

tellings.quote: And clearly people even he he was said this in my interview with him. People on the inside want this stuff together. They were extremely disgruntled.

plain: People inside the secret effort that David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, says has kept recovered craft of non-human origin, the so-called legacy program, wanted this material brought out and were "extremely disgruntled." Michels says Grusch told him this in his own interview with him, and he repeats it in a conversation with the analyst Matthew Pines; if true, it would mean the push for openness is coming partly from within the program itself.
